properties.description:
The hxm_program hub's running feedback log (AJ's agent sessions, a program hub over about ten beamline repos), uploaded by Anthony on 2026-09-28 as "new feedback (appended to the old)". 814 lines. The 2026-09-10 copy (art:hxm-program-feedback-2026-09-10, 423 lines) is a strict prefix of it except one line: an ADDENDUM dated 2026-09-11 was added inside the 09-09→10 section (line 296) saying the served version moved from 0.56.0 to 0.58.0 on a reconnect and nothing told the session.

WHAT IS NEW HERE AND WHAT WAS ALREADY TRIAGED:
· 2026-09-14 status-deck post-mortem (F-22 to F-25, O-13 to O-16): already captured as fact:field-report-hxm-a-progress-deck-was-written-from-a-checklist-and-recency-and-the-design-was-read-only-after-a-challenge and root-caused in fact:root-cause-the-status-claim-was-keyed-to-nothing-and-the-catalogue-spoke-the-designs-side-not-the-askers.
· 2026-09-14 first /feedback window ("the ledger is younger than the design"): NEW.
· 2026-09-23 (F-26, F-27): already triaged (fact:related-to-on-a-choice-passes-the-duplicate-guard-and-is-then-dropped-2026-09-23, fact:the-merge-rule-is-written-for-a-conventional-path-once-and-nothing-checks-the-real-export-2026-09-23).
· 2026-09-25 (F-28 export stamp size, F-29 add_capability with allocated_to answered "nothing moved"): NEW.
· 2026-09-28, "the hub as an operations brain" (F-30 to F-36, O-17 to O-24), against reflow2 0.73.0: NEW. The owner's framing, verbatim: "So far, I've used it mostly as a way to capture tasks at a beamline and a way to troubleshoot issues at a beamline and to document how we solve things ... much more focused on the later phases of deployment and operations and troubleshooting than the initial phases of concept to requirements to design to implementation of design."

REDACTION: the report names hosts, controllers and device signals at a workplace facility. Records drawn from it keep the SHAPE (a motion controller axis, an IOC on a host) and leave the names out, because this design's export is public (dec:field-reports-are-untracked-because-the-repository-is-public).

Registered and PARKED under dec:a-dated-field-report-is-registered-and-parked, and triaged under rule:field-feedback-issues-are-root-caused-and-ideas-are-brainstormed on Anthony's word, 2026-09-28: "as always, brainstorm proposed ideas and root-cause issues identified".
